description: This file contains theme styling and customizations for the Slick Carousel plugin, including variables for icons, colors, paths, functions to generate URLs for fonts and images, and CSS rules for arrows, dots, and the slider list.

methods.name: slick-image-url
methods.description: Returns the URL string for an image, using the image-url function if available, otherwise concatenates the loader path with the given URL.

methods.name: slick-font-url
methods.description: Returns the URL string for a font, using the font-url function if available, otherwise concatenates the font path with the given URL.
